messages.content: Hi there. Question - what kind of bread should I be eating with my type 2?
Good thinking - but I can't give diet advice. A nurse can walk through what works for your situation though. Want me to set that up?
Yeah, I'd like that. Nothing's worked so far
I'll escalate you now. Heads up: it's about 31 hours median wait right now, but they'll take good care of you on this.
You're set. Also - have you logged your meds for today? I can note them if you haven't
Perfect. Nurse will be in touch.
